title: Caruso with piano and orchestra
work: Ruggero Leoncavallo: Recitar!… Vesti la giubba
question: How does Caruso shape the shared vocal passage with piano in 1902 and orchestra in 1907?
intro: Caruso recorded Gramophone matrix 2875b with pianist Salvatore Cottone in Milan on 30 November 1902, and Victor C-4317 with orchestra in New York on 17 March 1907. These are different acoustic masters, not the later electrically re-orchestrated dubs of the Victor recording. The provisional map compares only 5–114 seconds of the piano side with 13–139 seconds of the orchestral side; the complete streams retain their different openings and later continuations. A two-semitone difference between their analysed pitch profiles is compensated in features only, without changing playback or treating the excerpt-duration ratio as a whole-side tempo comparison.
